Method of Attack: Injects malicious GitHub Actions code into forked repositories to mine cryptocurrency on GitHub servers
Malicious Pull Requests trigger automated workflows that execute crypto miners
Downloads and runs a misnamed crypto miner executable (npm.exe) from GitLab with attacker’s wallet address
Copycat attacks use open-source XMRig crypto-miner from official GitHub repository
Attack Vector: Forking legitimate repositories with GitHub Actions enabled, injecting malicious code, and filing Pull Requests
Automated execution of malicious code via GitHub Actions workflows triggered by Pull Requests
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious executable named npm.exe hosted on GitLab
ci.yml file modified by attacker specifying pool servers
